# Data

This directory holds the **data contract** between the pipeline and the site: versioned JSON files generated by `npm run data:compute` and read only through `lib/data/` (pages never import these files). The second half documents the **Riksdagen input** that `npm run data:fetch` downloads, as actually observed on 2026-10-20.

Source: [Riksdagens öppna data](https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/dokument-och-lagar/riksdagens-oppna-data/). **Källa: Sveriges riksdag.**

## Generated files (data contract)

```bash
npm run data:fetch     # Riksdagen → .cache/riksdagen/ (validated)
npm run data:summarize # optional: generated summaries → data/generated-summaries.json (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
npm run data:compute   # .cache/riksdagen/ (+ generated summaries) → data/ (deterministic)
npm run data:check     # validate data/ exactly as the site build reads it
```

Schemas: `lib/data/schemas.ts` (zod, strict — unknown keys are rejected). Types: `lib/data/types.ts`. Builder: `lib/pipeline/build.ts`. Every file has `schemaVersion` (currently `2`; `2` added `documents/`, `rubrik` in vote entries and member `ballots`, replacing `missedVoteIds`) and `source` (`"Sveriges riksdag"`); bump `schemaVersion` on any breaking change.

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `meta.json` | `defaultPeriodId`, `lastVoteDate` (newest vote in the data), `sourceUrl`, and `periods[]`: `id`, `label`, `kind` (`term`/`riksmote`), `riksmoten`, `complete`, `totalVotes`, `minEligibleVotes`, `firstVoteDate`, `lastVoteDate` |
| `ranking/{periodId}.json` | `totalVotes`, `minEligibleVotes`, `ranked[]` (`rank`, `memberId`, `name`, `party`, `constituency`, summary) best first, `belowThreshold[]` (same without `rank`) by name |
| `parties.json` | Per period: `parties[]` with `party`, `memberCount`, pooled summary, `rankedMembers` and `spread` (`min`/`median`/`max` attendance of ranked members whose latest party in the period it is; `null` if none), best first |
| `members.json` | Index of everyone in the data: `id`, `name`, `party`, `constituency` (latest), by id |
| `members/{id}.json` | One member: `name`, `party`, `constituency` (latest vote), `firstName`, `lastName`, `sortName`, `status` (from `personlista`), `total` (all riksmöten in the data), `byRiksmote[]`, `periods[]` (`periodId`, `rank` or `null` if below the threshold, summary), `ballots[]` (see below) |
| `votes/{riksmote}.json` | Vote index, e.g. `votes/2025-26.json`: `id` (votering_id), `date`, `beteckning`, `punkt`, `avser`, `rubrik` (heading of the betänkande's proposal point; `null` for omröstningar or when unknown), `counts`, by date then id |
| `documents/{riksmote}.json` | What the votes are about, one entry per voted `beteckning`, by beteckning: `kind` (`betankande`/`omrostning`), `dokId` (links to riksdagen.se), `title`, `summary` (`null`, or `source` `riksdagen`/`generated`, `heading`, `blocks[]` of plain-text `p`/`li`, `model` for generated ones) |
| `generated-summaries.json` | **Pipeline input, not output** — summaries written by `data:summarize` for documents Riksdagen has not summarised, kept across runs (`riksmote`, `beteckning`, `dokId`, `model`, `generatedAt`, `heading`, `blocks`). `data:compute` uses one only while Riksdagen's own summary is missing and the `dokId` matches; `data:summarize` drops it once Riksdagen publishes one |

**Ballots**: `ballots[]` has one entry per riksmöte in which the member has at least one ballot: `{ riksmote, votes }`, where `votes` has one character per vote of `votes/{riksmote}.json`, in that file's order — `J` Ja, `N` Nej, `A` Avstår, `F` Frånvarande, `-` no ballot (not serving). `lib/data/` checks on read that each string has the vote file's length and adds up to the member's `byRiksmote` counts, so a misaligned file fails the build. The site also publishes each riksmöte's vote list as static JSON (`/data/voteringar/{riksmote}.json`: `[id, date, beteckning, punkt, motivfrågan 0/1, rubrik]` plus titles), which the member page joins with the ballot string in the browser.

**Summaries are plain text.** Riksdagen's "Beslut i korthet" is HTML; the fetch step converts it to paragraphs and list items (`lib/riksdagen/html-text.ts`) and the site renders only that text, never source HTML.

A **summary** is `counts` (`ja`, `nej`, `avstar`, `franvarande`), `eligible`, `present` and `attendance` (`present / eligible`, 0–1, **unrounded** — the site rounds for display). Calculation rules: [docs/specs/TASK-004.md](../docs/specs/TASK-004.md).

**Refresh**: `.github/workflows/data-refresh.yml` runs fetch → compute → check daily and commits `data/` to `main` only when it changed (commits by `github-actions[bot]`, `chore(data): …`). Completed riksmöten come from the Actions cache; a manual run with *refresh* re-downloads them.

**Periods**: `2022-2026` (the whole 2022–2026 term, the default) and one per riksmöte, `2022-23` … `2026-27`. Each period is ranked on its own, with its own threshold (10 % of the period's votes). `2026-27` is the riksmöte in progress (`complete: false`).

**Not published**: birth year, gender, portrait URL and contact details — not needed for the attendance figures.

**Deterministic**: the same cache gives byte-identical files (fixed key order, explicit sorting, 2-space indent). There is deliberately no `generatedAt` timestamp, so a run without new votes produces no diff; `lastVoteDate` shows how current the data is and the git history shows when it was generated.

**Size**: `data/` is build input only — it is not published as-is; the site publishes pre-rendered pages. Snapshot with votes up to 2026-10-15: 585 files, 5.2 MB (the ballot strings are smaller than the former `missedVoteIds`); member files ≈ 3.7 MB, `documents/` ≈ 1.2 MB, each ranking file ≈ 100–200 kB.

## Fetch pipeline

`npm run data:fetch` (add `-- --refresh` to ignore the cache) writes to `.cache/riksdagen/` (git-ignored):

| File | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `raw/dataset/votering-{rm}.json.zip` | Bulk vote dataset, as downloaded |
| `raw/votering/{votering_id}.json` | `/votering/{id}/json` responses (never change once a vote is held) |
| `raw/voteringlista/{rm}-by-vote.json` | Vote index per riksmöte (`gruppering=votering_id`) |
| `raw/personlista-tjanst.json` | `/personlista/?rdlstatus=tjanst` |
| `votes-{rm}.json` | Validated, normalised votes (see `lib/riksdagen/normalized.ts`) |
| `raw/dokumentlista/bet-{rm}-{page}.json` | Betänkanden of the riksmöte (`/dokumentlista/?doktyp=bet`), re-fetched every run |
| `raw/utskottsforslag/{dok_id}.json` | Proposal points of a voted betänkande (kept; re-fetched in the current riksmöte when a voted point is missing) |
| `documents-{rm}.json` | Validated, normalised vote documents: title, "Beslut i korthet" as text blocks, proposal-point headings |
| `members.json` | Validated, normalised members: only people who appear in the vote data |
| `manifest.json` | Per riksmöte: source, complete, counts, fetch time |
| `observed.json` | Value sets seen in the last run (basis for the tables below) |

Riksmöten: 2022/23–2025/26 (2022–2026 term, cached once complete) and 2026/27 (current, refreshed on every run). Read the normalised files with `readRiksmoteVotes()` and `readMembers()` from `lib/riksdagen/cache.ts`.

### How votes are assembled

1. The **vote index** (`/voteringlista/?rm=…&gruppering=votering_id`) decides which votes exist and how many `Ja`/`Nej`/`Avstår`/`Frånvarande` each has.
2. Rows come from the **bulk dataset** `/dataset/votering/votering-{rm}.json.zip` when Riksdagen publishes one (one JSON file per vote).
3. Votes in the index but missing from the dataset, and every vote when there is no dataset yet (the current riksmöte), are fetched from **`/votering/{id}/json`**. *Omröstningar* (e.g. the vote on a new prime minister) have no rows there; they are read from `/voteringlista/?rm=…&bet={beteckning}`.
4. Every vote's per-`rost` counts must equal the index, or the run aborts.
5. Dataset votes that are **not in the index** are excluded and listed in `observed.json` (see below).

### How documents are assembled

Every vote has a `beteckning`. For a betänkande (e.g. `JuU41`) the pipeline finds it in `/dokumentlista/?doktyp=bet&rm=…` (title, `notisrubrik`, `notis` = "Beslut i korthet") and reads the heading of each voted point from `/utskottsforslag/{dok_id}.json`. Omröstningar (`MMDD-N`, e.g. the vote on a prime minister) have no betänkande; their title comes from the vote document (`/votering/{id}/json`). A beteckning shared by several betänkanden, or with no document, is reported in `observed.json` and shown without a topic — topics never affect the attendance figures, so this does not abort the run.

Observed 2026-10-21: every voted betänkande was found and had a "Beslut i korthet"; every vote in a betänkande had a point heading. Only the 6 omröstningar lack a summary. `dok_id` and `beteckning` can contain `ö` (`HA01FöU9`, `UFöU1`); page URLs use an ASCII slug (`fou9`).

## Vote rows

One row per seat per vote: every vote has exactly **349 rows**. A member on leave has no row; their ersättare (substitute) has one. The Speaker (talman) never has a row — the talmansersättare votes in that seat.

| Field (raw) | Normalised | Observed |
|-------------|------------|----------|
| `votering_id` | `Vote.id` | GUID, upper-cased (shared by all rows of a vote) |
| `rm` | `Vote.riksmote` | e.g. `2025/26` |
| `beteckning` | `Vote.beteckning` | Committee report (`JuU22`) or omröstning `MMDD-N` (`1015-1`) |
| `punkt` | `Vote.punkt` | Integer; `0` for omröstningar |
| `avser` | `Vote.avser` | `sakfrågan`, `motivfrågan`, `frågan` (omröstningar only) |
| `votering` | — | Always `huvud` (validated, then dropped) |
| `datum` | `Vote.date` | `YYYY-MM-DD` (time part, when present, is `00:00:00`). `null` for omröstningar in the dataset — taken from the vote document instead |
| `intressent_id` | `Ballot.memberId` | Numeric string; joins to `personlista` |
| `namn`, `parti`, `valkrets` | `name`, `party`, `constituency` | As at the time of the vote |
| `rost` | `Ballot.rost` | **`Ja`, `Nej`, `Avstår`, `Frånvarande`** — no other value seen in any riksmöte |

Raw fields dropped: `hangar_id`, `fornamn`, `efternamn`, `kon`, `fodd`, `iort`, `banknummer`, `valkretsnummer`, plus `dok_id`, `punkttyp`, `systemdatum`, `votering_url_xml` in API rows. `voteringlista` rows have **no `datum`**.

### Observed per riksmöte

| Riksmöte | Votes | Rows | People | First – last vote | Ja | Nej | Avstår | Frånvarande | From API |
|----------|------:|-----:|-------:|-------------------|---:|----:|-------:|------------:|---------:|
| 2022/23 | 566 | 197 534 | 402 | 2022-10-17 – 2023-09-13 | 120 132 | 33 205 | 16 587 | 27 610 | 2 |
| 2023/24 | 595 | 207 655 | 382 | 2023-10-25 – 2024-09-25 | 121 353 | 36 359 | 19 019 | 30 924 | 1 |
| 2024/25 | 652 | 227 548 | 370 | 2024-09-25 – 2025-06-18 | 131 871 | 39 235 | 22 972 | 33 470 | 0 |
| 2025/26 | 797 | 278 153 | 375 | 2025-09-17 – 2026-08-13 | 173 861 | 54 186 | 20 547 | 29 559 | 0 |
| 2026/27 | 1 | 349 | 349 | 2026-10-15 | 99 | 248 | 0 | 2 | 1 |

`avser`: `motivfrågan` 5–14 votes per riksmöte; `frågan` only for omröstningar (PM votes, no-confidence votes).

`parti` values in vote rows: `S`, `M`, `SD`, `C`, `V`, `KD`, `L`, `MP` and **`-`** (politisk vilde — member without a party group; 227–5 396 rows per riksmöte).

### Known source discrepancies

| Riksmöte | Issue | Handling |
|----------|-------|----------|
| 2022/23 | Dataset lacks the PM vote `1017-1` (2022-10-17) and `KU32` (2023-06-16) | Fetched from the API |
| 2023/24 | Dataset lacks the no-confidence vote `0117-1` (2024-01-17) | Fetched from the API |
| 2024/25 | Dataset has 4 votes not in the index — `SkU3` p1 ×2 (2024-10-16), `FiU6` p1 and p2 (2024-11-06) — with 339–344 of 349 `Frånvarande`: evidently voided votes | Excluded |
| 2025/26 | Dataset has `SfU31` p1 on 2026-06-15 (174–172), not in the index; the index has `SfU31` p1 held again on 2026-06-17 | Excluded (the re-held vote is kept) |

Other source quirks: dataset zip entry names can contain stray non-ASCII bytes; `/votering/{id}/json` returns an empty `200` for votes not in the index; unknown `voteringlista` query parameters are silently ignored (the pipeline checks `@villkor`), and results are silently truncated at 10 000 rows (the pipeline checks `@antal`).

## Members

`/personlista/?rdlstatus=tjanst` returns everyone who has served since 2018 (773 people). People without an `intressent_id` (148 — Riksbank, JO and other officials who never sat in the chamber) and anyone without a vote in the configured riksmöten are dropped: **566 members** remain.

| Field (raw) | Normalised | Observed |
|-------------|------------|----------|
| `intressent_id` | `id` | Numeric string |
| `tilltalsnamn`, `efternamn`, `sorteringsnamn` | `firstName`, `lastName`, `sortName` | |
| `parti`, `valkrets` | `party`, `constituency` | **Current** values; may be empty for former members |
| `status` | `status` | e.g. `Tjänstgörande riksdagsledamot`, `Tidigare riksdagsledamot`, `Tillgänglig ersättare`, `Tjänstgörande statsrådsersättare`, minister titles, `Avliden  YYYY-MM-DD` (two spaces) |
| `fodd_ar` | `birthYear` | Four digits, or empty → `null` |
| `kon` | `gender` | `man`, `kvinna` (`Okänt` exists in the full list, not among voters) |
| `bild_url_192` | `imageUrl` | `https://data.riksdagen.se/filarkiv/bilder/ledamot/…_192.jpg` |
| `personuppdrag.uppdrag[]` (`organ_kod = kam`) | `chamberAssignments[]` | See below |

Chamber assignments (`organ_kod = kam`):

- `roll_kod`: `Riksdagsledamot`, `Ersättare`, `Statsrådsersättare`, `Talmansersättare`, `Förste/Andre/Tredje vice talman` (and `Talman` in the full list)
- `status`: `Tjänstgörande`, `Ledig`, `Ersättare`, `Ledig Ersättare`, and empty (11 rows)
- `from`/`tom`: `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`; `tom` may be empty (open-ended) → `to: null`

Not used: `/dataset/person/person.json.zip` (every file inside is 2 bytes) and `person.csv.zip`.
